current.test_revision: None. The exact frozen seven new cases, 45 earlier cases, and two raw fixtures were rerun without modification.
current.conclusion: No blocker found in this bounded qualification/measurement review.

fixed_qualification: Reservation is selected by captured binding.reservation_id and checked against the full attempt Ref, task, terminal digest and permit identity.
Controller closure must equal the captured READY binding; each native terminal closure must equal its captured supervision binding and full Ref.
Final trace has the exact attempt universe; observations/artifacts match terminal ID sets, published records and evaluator/producer full Refs.
CLI clocks are finite/nonnegative with consistent elapsed time; trace clocks are ordered and lie within the invocation; worker/native durations are finite/nonnegative.
static_review.source_and_wheel: Required --core-wheel records full wheel SHA/bytes and verifies each orze/ wheel member against installed package bytes, including exact Python member set. capture_sources re-enumerates application tracked/untracked files and installed Core Python files both before and after.
static_review.deadline: Main requires at least 60 seconds remaining before starting a scheduled invocation; after READY, at least 20 seconds must remain before GO. Wait is bounded by min(30, remaining-minus-10), with a separate owned 10-second STOP cleanup. This review verifies those code paths statically, not arbitrary blocking-OS timing.
static_review.denominator: Formal aggregation keeps all 24 planned pairs and 48 planned CLI entries, reports executed/unexecuted and failed-quality/nonzero-or-unknown exits plus native outcomes/observation statuses, and emits group medians only when every one of its six pairs qualifies. Missing/failed pairs are not silently replaced.
static_review.comparison: Pair eligibility requires identical selected task/candidate/cost/protocol/comparison scope/dataset/action signature. Differences are B-minus-A; the preregistered action-count hypothesis is reported separately from quality.
limits: The added source/wheel/deadline paths were read statically here; this 52-test invocation does not execute main(), install a wheel, start a CLI, or prove deployment.
The existing pytest autouse hardware-isolation fixture is loaded, but these tests call only pure Policy/JSON qualification functions. They are not described as unpatched production runs.
Diagnostic traces and archived metadata are consistency evidence, not execution authority, cryptographic attestation or independently recomputed domain validity.
Installed package members are verified at admission; ongoing inventory scope is installed Core Python plus the application examples trees, not every operating-system/dependency file.
No formal 48-run result, statistical independence, broad research acceleration, or scientific/LLM/GPU benefit is established by this review.
